name: Registration Confirm Email Address
description: Adds a confirm email address field under email address field on registration form.
project_description:
The module adds a confirm email address field under email address field in the registration form.

 
 This module extracts LoginToboggan's email confirmation feature. 

 If you want your users to rewrite their email address during registration, but don't want to install the whole LoginToboggan module, then this module is for you.

 
 
 
 
 
 Register Form example 
 
 
 
 Configuration example 
 
 
 
 
 
 Usage of the module 
 

 
 Download, install and enable the module 
 Go to "admin/config/people/accounts" 
 Enable confirm email by ticking the "Use two e-mail fields on registration form" under "Confirm email address" 
 

 
 
 
 
 Documentation 
 Try on Drupal 8
